'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Aaron Nelson DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck name '''Space, Spice, Baby!'''. Username varies on sheets (Antog/Andy/Anelson); dest [[Aaron Nelson]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' Anelson2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
